resources.string: Configure built-in controller mapping, on-screen touch controls, and SDL controller routing.
Edit the same built-in controller options available from the in-game settings button.
Show or hide on-screen controls and manage imported/custom touch layouts.
Older controller mods might require this example Controllable 1.20.1.
Auto-hide touch controls with controller: ON
Auto-hide touch controls with controller: OFF

When a controller is connected, keep every on-screen touch button hidden. Touching the screen still controls Minecraft but does not reveal the buttons. They return automatically after the controller disconnects.
Allows empty-screen touch taps and long presses to send Minecraft attack/use gestures. Turn this off if you only want touch buttons and camera movement.
When Minecraft touch gestures are enabled, double-tapping the empty look area sends the Drop key.
Double tap hotbar to swap offhand: On
Double tap hotbar to swap offhand: Off
Double-tapping the same in-game hotbar slot sends the Minecraft Swap Item With Offhand key. This is separate from double tap to drop.
